cards.imageAlt: 起飞时发动机起火，用于本话题的看图描述和问答
cards.taskTitle: 起飞时发动机起火 · 看图材料

cards.audioText: Can you describe what is happening in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述图中正在发生什么吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes. The picture is taken in the vicinity of the airport. We can see a Concorde taking off, there's heavy flame and dense smoke coming from the rear belly of the aircraft. The landing gear is still down.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的，这张照片拍摄于机场附近。图中可以看到一架协和飞机正在起飞，飞机后腹部有火焰和浓烟。因为飞机起落架仍是放下状态。

cards.audioText: Can you guess what possibly caused the accident?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能设想这起事故可能是由什么原因引发的吗？
cards.referenceText: I know this accident. Concorde, the supersonic aircraft with delta wings was on fire shortly after takeoff. It was grounded after this accident. The official reason which had been reported was that a strip of metal lying on the runway caused a tire on the left main gear to burst, and the resulting explosion ignited fuel in the left wing tank.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我知道这起事故。一架协和飞机，有三角机翼的超音速飞机，起飞后很快地起火了。事故发生后飞机停飞，官方报道的事故原因是跑道上的一条金属引发左边的主起落架轮胎爆胎，爆胎引起的爆炸点燃了左机翼油箱的燃料。

cards.audioText: What's supersonic aircraft? Is B787 a supersonic aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是超音速飞机？波音787是超音速飞机吗？
cards.referenceText: No, B787 isn't supersonic aircraft. A supersonic aircraft is an aircraft able to fly faster than the speed of sound. As far as I know, the Concorde is the only supersonic aircraft in commercial operation, but it is grounded now.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不，波音787不是超音速飞机。超音速飞机是指速度能够高于音速的飞机。就我所知，目前的商业运作中只有协和机型是超音速飞机，现在已经停飞了。

cards.audioText: Based on your knowledge, do you think there are some other reasons that could cause the crash possibly?
cards.audioTextZh: 在你的知识基础上，你认为是否还有其它原因可能引发这种事故？
cards.referenceText: Yes. It is possible that a design fault could lead to the crash. Maybe part of the landing gear pierces the tire and the resulting explosion ignites the fuel tank. Besides, parts of the failed engine entering the fuel tank and starting the initial fire may be a possible reason, too.
cards.referenceTextZh: 有，设计上的错误可能也会引发事故。可能是主起落架的一部分刺入轮胎引发的爆炸点燃了油箱。此外，也可能是因为故障发动机的一部分进入油箱并引发初期火灾。

cards.audioText: If you were the captain on board, what should you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你是飞机的机长，你应该怎样做？
cards.referenceText: If I were the captain, I would stop the aircraft on the runway when the runway is long enough. Then I would declare an emergency, finish the checklist if necessary and evacuate as soon as possible. When the runway is not long enough, I would climb to optimum altitude, then land at nearest airport or return to the runway, at the same time I would declare emergency.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果我是这架飞机的机长，跑道足够长的话我会让飞机停在跑道上，宣布紧急情况，执行检查单如果有必要，尽快撤离。若跑道不够长，我会尽快拉升到有利高度，就近迫降或者放回到跑道上，同时宣布紧急情况。

cards.audioText: Under this situation, how to execute emergency evacuation?
cards.audioTextZh: 在这种情况下，如何进行紧急撤离？
cards.referenceText: First, we must report to ATC that we are going to make emergency evacuation after landing and ask them to provide emergency services on arrival. Second, we must notify cabin crew to prepare for it. After landing we will carry out emergency evacuation procedures and ask passengers to evacuate from the forward cabin doors.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先，我们必须向ATC报告我们将在着陆后进行紧急撤离，并向ATC要求到达后的紧急服务。第二，我们必须通知机组成员为紧急撤离做准备。着陆后我们要执行紧急撤离程序，并且要求乘客从前机舱门进行撤离。

cards.audioText: Under this circumstance, what kind of help can ATC provide for flight crew?
cards.audioTextZh: 在这种情况下，ATC可以为机组成员提供什么样的帮助？
cards.referenceText: ATC can give the pilot landing priority and help them to make an emergency landing. ATC can also provide current weather information and emergency services such as fire trucks, first aid, and ambulances.
cards.referenceTextZh: ATC可以为飞行员提供着陆优先权，并且帮助飞行员进行紧急迫降。ATC也可以提供当前天气信息和紧急服务，例如消防车、急救和救护车。

cards.audioText: What lessons can we learn from this accident?
cards.audioTextZh: 从这起事故中我们能学到什么？
cards.referenceText: First, the airport authority should keep monitoring runway conditions and make sure there is no debris on the runway. Second, maybe supersonic aircraft are not safe enough for civil aviation operation, so before we know the real reason of this accident, the Concorde should be grounded.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先，机场管理局应该持续监控跑道状况并确保跑道上没有任何碎片。第二，可能超音速飞机在民用航空操作中还不够安全，所以在了解事故真正的原因前协和飞机应该被停飞。
